project_title: How to Create Unlimited Animated Reels Using One Claude Skill

scenes.name: THE_HOOK
scenes.voiceover: Did you know one Claude skill could help you create animated Reels at scale?
scenes.entrance: Staggered headline slide down with spring overshoot, floating cards scaling in from sides
scenes.main_action: Oversized typography staggered reveal with coral orange highlight; cards floating with sine physics
scenes.exit: Smooth zoom push and horizontal card split transition

scenes.name: INTRODUCE_THE_SKILL
scenes.voiceover: Instead of building every video from scratch, start with a reusable skill.
scenes.entrance: Skill card slides up from bottom with rotation settling at 0deg
scenes.main_action: Card unfolds into dark coding interface displaying skill configuration headers and metadata
scenes.exit: Terminal scales down into input prompt box

scenes.name: DESCRIBE_THE_WORKFLOW
scenes.voiceover: Give it your idea, and let the workflow organize the scenes, visuals, and animations.
scenes.entrance: Prompt box appears center, typing cursor active
scenes.main_action: Pulsing orange connector line flows from IDEA node into SCENES storyboard chips, then into ANIMATION cards
scenes.exit: Pipeline chips fan out and transform into full illustration canvas

scenes.name: VISUAL_POSSIBILITIES
scenes.voiceover: From colorful illustrations to moving characters, each scene can tell a different part of the story.
scenes.entrance: Cyan and deep blue gradient fills viewport with gentle water caustic ripple
scenes.main_action: Multi-layer parallax: tropical fish swim across with tail wag physics, kelp and sea plants sway, bubbles rise
scenes.exit: Gentle upward camera drift into daylight editorial space

scenes.name: SHOW_VARIETY
scenes.voiceover: Combine different scenes, compositions, and visual styles to keep every moment interesting.
scenes.entrance: Grid container springs in with staggered card arrivals (slide, scale, diagonal mask)
scenes.main_action: Four distinct visual styles displayed simultaneously: kinetic typography, 3D isometric card, vector art, minimal data
scenes.exit: Cards fold together toward center card

scenes.name: MAKE_IT_A_STORY
scenes.voiceover: The goal isn't just movement. Every visual should support the message you're telling.
scenes.entrance: Warm editorial desk illustration scales gently from center with soft shadow
scenes.main_action: Creator typing at modern desk, steaming coffee cup animation, ambient lamp glow, purposeful badges floating
scenes.exit: Desk illustration slides into video editing preview monitor

scenes.name: EDITING_PROCESS
scenes.voiceover: Then bring the pieces together into a complete vertical video.
scenes.entrance: Video editor interface emerges with dark UI chassis and glowing track headers
scenes.main_action: Timeline tracks populate with Video, Subtitles, Audio, and SFX blocks; red playhead sweeps smoothly
scenes.exit: Interface timeline expands into full focus view

scenes.name: EXPLAIN_AUTOMATION
scenes.voiceover: With a reusable workflow, repetitive production steps can become much easier to manage.
scenes.entrance: Focus on multitrack timeline clips snapping into magnetic alignment
scenes.main_action: Clips arrange sequentially with micro-bounces, orange highlight sweep confirms automated sync
scenes.exit: Timeline zooms out into completed video library

scenes.name: REVEAL_RESULTS
scenes.voiceover: One workflow can support many different video concepts.
scenes.entrance: Grid of completed vertical-video reels floats into view with 3D perspective
scenes.main_action: 6 completed reels displayed with distinct themes, vibrant cover art, and smooth ambient hovering

scenes.name: SHOW_APPLICATIONS
scenes.voiceover: Think educational explainers, creative stories, product demos, and animated tutorials.
scenes.entrance: 4 quadrant cards present with crisp borders
scenes.main_action: Sequential spotlight highlights each quadrant one by one in sync with narration words
scenes.exit: Quadrants converge into a single transformable project card

scenes.name: EMPHASIZE_REUSABILITY
scenes.voiceover: Change the topic, update the assets, and adapt the scenes to your next idea.
scenes.entrance: Central project card cycles through 3 distinct themes (Tech -> Finance -> Lifestyle)
scenes.main_action: Topic pill flips, assets update seamlessly while core workflow structure stays rock-solid; user character gestures
scenes.exit: Card scales up to establish final backdrop

scenes.name: FINAL_CALL_TO_ACTION
scenes.voiceover: Want to build your own animated Reel workflow? Start with one skill, refine the process, and create your next video.
scenes.entrance: Cream background holds strong; bold black headline stamps in with coral orange badges
scenes.main_action: Central message card pulses with confidence; user character points forward; hold frame for complete readability
scenes.exit: Graceful hold at frame 1486 with final freeze
